csv_scope_of_work: The Facilities Management Department is soliciting qualifications/proposals from qualified firms to provide on-call as-needed professional civil engineering services. The Town will accept either individual firm submittals or team submittals from two or more firms. It is the Town s intent to enter into contracts with a qualified firm to provide services on an as-needed basis. The Town will have sole discretion as to which projects, if any, will be assigned to the Consultant. The selected consultant and/or consultant teams shall provide comprehensive engineering services including, but not limited to, repair, modification, and new site, civil, structural, and geotechnical, for the preparation and support of complete construction drawings, specifications, estimates, contract administration, project inspection, and planning services or studies, as required (building inspection, code compliance review/advice, feasibility studies). The selected consultant shall be familiar with local, state, and federal building requirements.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Cost Estimating, Feasibility Studies, Inspection Services, Planning/Master Planning, Structural Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering
